raw_translation: Chombo hiki inajenga na kuangalia HS256 tokens na siri HMAC. Ni si kujenga au kuthibitisha RSA, ECDSA, EdDSA au algorithms nyingine.
source: This tool creates and checks HS256 tokens with an HMAC secret. It does not create or verify RSA, ECDSA, EdDSA or other algorithms.
translation: Chombo hiki inajenga na kuangalia HS256 tokens na siri HMAC. Ni si kujenga au kuthibitisha RSA, ECDSA, EdDSA au algorithms nyingine.
